exposure: Indications for surgery (respiratory distress, lesion size)
cohort: The study included 49 symptomatic infants with congenital lung malformations (CLM) who underwent thoracotomy for resectional surgery during the neonatal period at a single center.
finding: The study found that 12% of congenital lung malformation cases treated with neonatal surgery were associated with mucinous adenocarcinoma, and both antenatal intervention and emergency surgery were linked to a higher incidence of postnatal complications such as pneumothorax and increased respiratory support.
